text:
Marta: Quick heads-up — noticed a few broken links and one image 403 on the KB page /guides/runtime/overview after the CSS deploy. Noticed while triaging a ticket from support. Can someone from docs ownership take a look? Sample broken links: https://kb.redwood.ai/guides/runtime/overview#cli-demo -> 404, and the architecture diagram image returns 403.
Joel: I can pick this up in a bit. Do you have the exact anchor or a screenshot?
Marta: Thanks @Joel. Anchor is the 'CLI demo' H2 near the bottom. Screenshot attached in Zendesk ticket #4238 (link: https://zendesk.redwood.ai/tickets/4238). I also saw the same 404 in staging. Seems like a redirect change from last week.
docs-bot: Automated scan found 3 dead anchors and 1 403 in /guides/runtime/overview (scan id: scan-2026-03-18-08). Report: /guides/runtime/overview -> anchors: #cli-demo (404), #quickstart (302->404), #examples (404); assets: /images/architecture-v2.svg -> 403.
Sam: Reassigning to @Joel as primary owner for this page. Joel, if you need a quick PR template: sed -i 's|/old-path/|/new-path/|g' docs/guides/runtime/overview.md and update frontmatter redirects.
Joel: Got it. I'll run the redirect lookup now. If this is from the CDN shortlink swap, might be a simple shortlink->canonical fix. Will open a PR.
Leo: Note: if the image is served from staging bucket with restricted ACL after the infra change, we might need an ops patch. Ping @infra if ACLs need updating.
Marta: FYI, support flagged one customer impact: the CLI snippet 404 prevents onboarding flow. Would prefer a canary PR and quick rollback if anything goes wrong.
Joel: Plan: 1) confirm redirect map, 2) create a micro-PR updating anchors and image path, 3) request an infra check for image ACL if PR doesn't fix it. I'll post PR link here when ready.
(30m later) Joel: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — updates anchors, replaces the image path with /assets/arch/architecture-v2.svg, adds a tiny redirect in frontmatter. Requesting reviews from @Marta and @Sam.
Sam: LGTM on quick scan. @infra please confirm asset ACLs are fine in prod.
docs-bot: deploy-bot: docs site preview available at https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/guides/runtime/overview?pr=4123 (preview expires in 48h).
(45m later) Joel: Infra confirmed via #eng-infra — image bucket had a policy that blocked the preview domain; ops toggled the policy and verified GETs succeed. Marking this as fixed from infra side.
Marta: Verified the staging preview — links resolve, image loads. Thanks everyone. I'll update the Zendesk ticket with the PR and mark ready-for-close.
Leo: Small follow-up: can we add a one-liner to the docs checklist to double-check shortlink redirects after CDNs/shortlink updates? Might prevent this leak.
Sam: Good call. Can someone file a quick repo issue? If nobody does it in the next hour I'll create one.
Joel: Filed issue #987: "Docs checklist: validate shortlink/redirects after CDN changes" and added a small checklist item.
Marta: Closing loop — support notified, ticket updated. Thanks @Joel and @infra team. :thumbsup:
